npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: God save you. What news of the parish?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: God save ye kindly, friend — 'tis a fine spring mornin' at the forge! The only news worth repeating is word from a drover that the land agent means to evict tenants over in the next county; bad business if it spreads our way. What brings ye to these parts so early?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his hands on his leather apron and grins.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Ah, the seed's only going into the ground this week, so the harvest is with God yet — but the signs are fair. A farmer who's given up doesn't bring his spade to be sharpened, and I've had a steady stream of them this fortnight. Are ye putting in a crop yourself?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his hands on his leather apron and nods toward the lane.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Have you seen Father Declan today?

response_lines.speaker: System
response_lines.text: Fr. Declan Tierney is not here.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I've not seen Fr. Declan this mornin' — he don't often come by the forge until the day's well up, unless there's ailing folk to visit. Ye'll likely find him at the church, or on the road between it and the cottages. Are ye needing a word with him?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his hands on his apron, glancing up the lane.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: And how is your own family keeping?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Ah, we're all well, Buíochas le Dia — Maire keeps the house in order and this lad here is shaping up grand at the anvil; he'll be swinging a hammer as heavy as my own before long.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron jerks a thumb proudly toward young Colm.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I know no cooper by that name in these parts, mo chara — nor any shop by a bridge, for that matter. There's no bridge hereabouts at all, only the ford below the mill; mayhap ye're thinking of another parish entirely.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his hands on his leather apron and shakes his head.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How do I get to the abbey in town?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: An abbey, is it? There's no abbey in these parts, friend — nor any town to speak of, only the villages. Ye'd be better asking at the mill or the letter office; mayhap someone there knows what ye're after.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his hands on his apron and squints at the newcomer.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Brief, is it? I'm a blacksmith, plain and simple — I shoe the horses, mend the ploughs and spades, and hear every bit of news the parish brings to the anvil. There's the whole of it, and the half of it's the gossip.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his hands on his leather apron and gestures at the hanging ironwork.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Worry's a thief that thrives on an idle man, mo chara — give yer hands work and the head settles soon enough; many a sleepless night I've hammered out of myself at this anvil. But a man don't lie awake for nothing. Is it some particular trouble that's keeping ye from yer rest?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron sets a horseshoe on the anvil and turns to face them, wiping his hands on his apron.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Aye, Padraig Darcy — he keeps the pub down at the crossroads; a decent man who pours a fair pint and hears more news than I do. Are ye looking for him this mornin'?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his hands on his apron and nods.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Ballyglass Castle, is it? I know no such place in these parts, friend — there's no castle hereabouts, only the villages and the farms. Mayhap ye'd find what ye're after further west, but ye've come to the wrong parish for castles.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his hands on his leather apron and squints at the newcomer.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Cormac Duffy is the miller, right enough, but I've not seen him myself this mornin' — the forge keeps me here, not the mill. Ye'd get a surer answer down at the mill, mo chara.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron shrugs and wipes his hands on his apron.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: No trouble at all, mo chara — the iron'll wait, and it's glad I am of the company. If ye're hunting news or a good pint, Padraig Darcy's the man; slán abhaile now.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron nods and turns back toward the anvil, reaching for a horseshoe.*
